text:
nina: Heads-up: after the last routing rollout some resumed streams show duplicated final chunks when clients reconnect quickly (200-400ms). Looks like proxy claims resume before runtime has updated the session KV.
oscar: Confirmed in logs for tenant t-442: proxy: resume accepted -> runtime: cache miss -> emit last_chunk again. Billing counted the duplicate.
rachel: Repro steps: disconnect network, immediately reconnect with resume_token; sometimes runtime hasn't reconciled.
ben: Suggest two-phase resume: proxy sends provisional accept + nonce, runtime must confirm within 250ms. Until confirmed, proxy should hold client-sent inputs or tag them provisional. If confirm fails, send control event instructing client to rewind/backoff.
deploy-bot: Rollout v3.2 -> 15% (2026-03-11T09:00Z)
ops-bot: Alert: resume_duplicate_detected spike for t-442 at 09:12
oscar: Telemetry needs: resume_phase (provisional|confirmed|expired), resume_nonce, resume_confirm_latency_ms, duplicate_emitted boolean, billed_during_provisional boolean.
rachel: Protocol: in-stream control events for SSE/WS, example SSE:
```
event: resume
data: {"status":"provisional","nonce":"n-77"}

event: resume
data: {"status":"confirmed","nonce":"n-77","last_seq":101}

```
ben: Short term: add feature flag to force runtime-confirm for all tenants; longer term implement provisional flow + billing protection. QA: create e2e tests with 100-500ms runtime delay.
nina: Action items: oscar implement metrics + dashboard annotation; rachel spec two-phase handshake; ben prototype proxy hold/confirm; QA create harness. Drop PR links here. Quick sync 09:45 to decide rollback or feature-flag flip.
